svg.title: Known-best packing of 68 unit squares
svg.desc: The retained known-best n=68 construction, normalized to Witness/v2 and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Exact rational corners from the retained centered source, checked with exact predicates at the full rational side. Drawing feasibility does not assign the imported result's confirmation rung. No optimality, rigidity or human oversight claim.

svg.text: U n=68 known best: side ~ 8.798795237 (certified upper bound)
